label: s32_st_mara_is_wrong
title: The One She Got Wrong
summary: The most important thing missing from Mara. She reads people accurately and the game had never once shown her reading one wrong, which turns her confidence into a mechanic instead of a trait. Here she is confident, specific, and wrong, and the player decides whether she finds out. The three things her bible separates -- what she knows, what she thinks she knows, what she says she knows -- come apart in one scene.
